maya_cs: Heads-up: BlueHorizon onboarding is stuck — they're seeing intermittent 429s on embedder calls during warmup. Raised ticket: https://tickets/INC-4802.

maya_cs: Quick log excerpt from their front end: `embedder-v1 POST 200ms -> 429 (retry-after: 2) x-retry-window: 1000ms`

connor_onboard: Do we know their concurrency pattern? single-page app or batch fanout from server?

maya_cs: SPA, but they preload 6 items in parallel on first view, and we see a spike right after token exchange. They said they spin up 8 webworkers for rendering.

jia_eng: Likely two things colliding: preflight/fanout + short-lived ephemeral tokens causing thundering refreshes. If token refreshes on each worker you get bursts. Also check HTTP/2 connection reuse — creating many new connections bypasses internal request coalescing.

connor_onboard: Agreed. Suggested immediate mitigations: (1) reduce parallel preloads to 2-3 while warmup, (2) reuse a single shared token across workers for 10s, (3) enable SDK keepAlive/connection pooling.

jia_eng: Example JS tweak we gave them to try: ```js
const client = new RedwoodEmbedClient({
  keepAlive: true,
  maxConcurrency: 3, // cap concurrent requests from page
  tokenLeewayMs: 5000, // accept slightly older tokens to avoid stampede
});
// also: debounce token refresh in central worker and broadcast to others
```

priya_se: I can run a quick preflight config from our side to confirm rate headers. can someone drop the request ids from their logs here?

maya_cs: Pasted three request ids in the ticket. Priya, infra-bot just flagged a transient quota alert earlier: `infra-bot: quota-protect: customer=bluehorizon, rule=burst-window, blocked=20 reqs`

infra-bot: alert created 1729456864 - quota-protect triggered for bluehorizon (burst-window). Recommend follow-up with CS/Eng.

jia_eng: On server side we can also add a short warmup grace for new API keys (10s soft-limit @ 5x baseline) to avoid immediate hard-429s for onboarding flows. That's a small change but needs a rollback plan.

connor_onboard: If we do a temporary soft-limit tweak, coordinate a canary and monitor per-key metrics. Priya — can you patch the staging rule and flip for bluehorizon key for 15 minutes?

priya_se: Yes, will deploy a staging rule now and enable for their key. I'll monitor headers like `x-rw-rate-limit-remaining` and `x-rw-rate-limit-reset` and report.

maya_cs: Heads-up — renewal conversation with Lisa next week is a risk window. If we can't get them live this week they may push decision. Flagging `renewal-risk` to AM.

lisa_am: Got it. I'll join the troubleshooting call and offer extended onboarding office hours if needed. Please ping me with a short status update after Priya tests.

priya_se: Staging rule applied for key bh-xxxx, enabling now. Initial sample: `x-rw-rate-limit-remaining: 45, reset-in: 12s`. After enabling keepAlive on client preview we saw 95% reduction in simultaneous connections.

maya_cs: Nice. BlueHorizon will try the client patch and reduce preload concurrency. I'll coordinate a 11am PST call for live verification.

jia_eng: Postmortem action items (short): 1) SDK doc update for onboarding patterns (preload guidance) 2) Add token refresh jitter example 3) Consider default keepAlive enabled in browser SDK 4) Short warmup soft-limit feature (ops gated).

connor_onboard: I'll own the SDK doc updates and run the 11am session.

lisa_am: I'll mention the mitigations in the renewal check-in and offer a one-week trial extension if they need more runway. :thumbsup:

maya_cs: Thanks team — will post a short status in the ticket after the call. :white_check_mark:
